name: Jonas Weber
bio: I collect overlooked corners of cities and the best coffee in each one.
description: Jonas is warm, patient, and happiest with a camera, a good map, and a slow afternoon. He has been trying to make more room for people who do not share his hobby.

questions.question: What makes you trust someone?
questions.answer: When their actions are kinder than their words.

clues.description: A familiar riverfront appears in two different photos.
clues.developerExplanation: Jonas photographs public architecture; repetition is a hobby rather than a hidden connection.

name: Felix Hartmann
bio: Daylight is underrated. So are reliable people and very strong tea.
description: Felix works irregular hours and has a dry sense of humor. He is private about work, mostly because he does not want to bring difficult stories home.

questions.question: Where would you disappear for a weekend?
questions.answer: A small cabin near a lake, with no phone signal.

questions.question: What would you never do again?
questions.answer: Agree to an overnight train without a window.

clues.description: His routine leaves large gaps in ordinary daytime activity.
clues.developerExplanation: Night-shift work explains the unusual hours, but the contact pattern makes it worth comparing.

clues.description: An unusually high number of current connections.
clues.developerExplanation: High activity is ambiguous and should read as a red herring.

name: Lukas Kern
bio: I repair old things for a living and overthink new things for free.
description: Lukas is careful, curious, and more relaxed around objects than crowds. His profile has a polished travel photo, though he says he rarely travels.

questions.question: Have you travelled much?
questions.answer: Not really. I have never left Bavaria, except for one conference in Berlin.

clues.description: A recent-looking photograph appears to show a Berlin landmark.
clues.developerExplanation: The image is intentionally ambiguous: it may be an old photo or a museum installation.

clues.description: His description of the Berlin visit is oddly specific and defensive.
clues.developerExplanation: The combined photo and chat pattern is suspicious but has an innocent explanation: the photo is from a work exhibition.

name: Noah Brandt
bio: Dog person, amateur baker, professional finder of lost socks.
description: Noah is easy to talk to and often lets his dog interrupt conversations. He is saving for a move closer to his sister.
intent: A good first date and see what happens

questions.question: What is your ideal first date?
questions.answer: A walk somewhere green followed by something warm from an oven.

name: Adrian Vogel
bio: I make complicated instructions less complicated. Still working on people.
description: Adrian is observant and a little guarded until he knows where he stands. He has an unfinished novel in a drawer and refuses to discuss the ending.

questions.question: What do people misunderstand about you?
questions.answer: That being quiet means I have nothing to say.

questions.question: What would you never do again?
questions.answer: Pretend a bad date was going well.

clues.description: Former inactive contacts are equal to current contacts.
clues.developerExplanation: The ratio is designed to feel suspicious but reflects a recent account reset after a breakup.

clues.description: Multiple answers emphasize privacy and unfinished stories.
clues.developerExplanation: Adrian is guarded but not dangerous; he is a strong innocent red herring.

name: Tobias Rehm
bio: The river is never the same twice. I like that about it.
description: Tobias spends much of his week outdoors assessing waterways. He is calm, direct, and sends photos of weather more often than selfies.
intent: Meet someone who enjoys the outside

questions.question: Where would you disappear for a weekend?
questions.answer: Anywhere with a footpath and a view of moving water.

clues.description: The light in one outdoor photo does not match the season in its caption.
clues.developerExplanation: The photo was taken by a colleague months earlier; the caption is a casual mistake.

name: Martin Falk
bio: Good routes, bad puns, and a soft spot for quiet restaurants.
description: Martin is charming without trying too hard. His work takes him through several cities, and his photos show a talent for making ordinary places feel memorable.

questions.question: Where would you disappear for a weekend?
questions.answer: Somewhere small, near water, where nobody needs anything from me.

questions.question: What makes you trust someone?
questions.answer: When they remember what they said last time.

clues.description: He says he has not been to Berlin since university, despite a recent-looking riverside image.
clues.developerExplanation: The profile wording is carefully plausible but conflicts with the photo metadata and later chat.

clues.description: A background landmark places one photo in Berlin after the claimed last visit.
clues.developerExplanation: The landmark is not prominent; it rewards looking closely at the gallery.

clues.description: He changes the explanation for the Berlin image instead of answering directly.
clues.developerExplanation: The key pattern is the profile-photo-chat contradiction, not any single line.

clues.description: His university timeline does not fit the travel timeline he implies elsewhere.
clues.developerExplanation: This becomes meaningful only after the player compares the second-stage answer with the profile.

clues.description: Contact history is ordinary but shows a cluster of short-lived connections.
clues.developerExplanation: Goggles should support the overall pattern lightly, never identify the killer by itself.

name: Elias Sturm
bio: I draw maps for a living and still get lost in supermarkets.
description: Elias has an unexpectedly dramatic way of describing ordinary things. He collects historic maps and enjoys the blank spaces more than the destinations.

questions.question: What is something people misunderstand about you?
questions.answer: That I am always confident. I just know where north is.

clues.description: Many current connections but very few inactive former contacts.
clues.developerExplanation: Elias joined several hobby groups through the app; the statistics are a false lead.

name: Samuel Klee
bio: Future train driver. Current collector of station coffee and bad puns.
description: Samuel is younger than most of the profiles here and eager to make a good impression. He has not travelled abroad yet, though he wants to change that.

questions.question: Have you travelled much?
questions.answer: I have never left Germany, but I am saving for a long train trip.

name: Daniel Weiss
bio: I keep complicated systems running and make excellent soup on callout nights.
description: Daniel is composed and practical, with a habit of turning questions into useful answers. His schedule is irregular but his stories are straightforward.
intent: A warm connection with room to breathe

questions.question: What does your perfect Sunday look like?
questions.answer: A late breakfast, a long walk, and no urgent notifications.

clues.description: Irregular emergency callouts make his schedule difficult to verify.
clues.developerExplanation: His employer confirms the schedule in the fictional case bible; this is a mild red herring.
